title: Pure Koa'ki Meiru
summary: Pure Koa'ki Meiru stun-and-swarm build centered on the four Level 4 EARTH Rock stun brothers—Guardian, Overload, Wall, and Sandman—paired with Beast-Warrior starters Urnight and Crusader. Diamond Core of Koa'ki Meiru searches any piece of the engine and banishes itself from the GY to protect all your Koa'ki Meiru monsters from destruction for the turn, including their End Phase maintenance costs.

summary.title: Starters
points: Diamond Core of Koa'ki Meiru searches any Koa'ki Meiru card from the Deck and banishes itself from the GY to make your Koa'ki Meiru monsters indestructible for the rest of the turn.
Koa'ki Meiru Urnight reveals Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru in your hand to Special Summon any Level 4 or lower Koa'ki Meiru monster directly from the Deck.

Koa'ki Meiru Supplier Special Summons itself from the hand whenever a face-up Rock monster you control is sent to the GY, then searches Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru or a card mentioning it (such as Urnight or Overload).
Fire Formation - Tenki searches Koa'ki Meiru Urnight or Koa'ki Meiru Crusader and boosts Beast-Warriors by 100 ATK.

summary.title: Opening: Ties of the Brethren or Urnight + Iron Core
steps: Route A (Rock Stun): Normal Summon any Level 4 EARTH Rock Koa'ki Meiru (Guardian, Overload, Wall, Sandman, or Supplier) and activate Ties of the Brethren to Special Summon two other Level 4 EARTH Rock Koa'ki Meiru monsters with different names from your Deck, placing Monster, Summon, and Spell/Trap negates on the board at once.

Route B (Urnight Swarm): Normal Summon Koa'ki Meiru Urnight and reveal Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru in hand to Special Summon Koa'ki Meiru Supplier from the Deck; Supplier searches another Rock stun brother or Iron Core, and the two Level 4s can overlay into Gallant Granite to search another Rock stun brother.

summary.title: The Four Rock Stun Brothers & Maintenance
summary.text: Koa'ki Meiru Guardian (monster effect negate), Koa'ki Meiru Overload (Summon negate), Koa'ki Meiru Wall (Spell negate), and Koa'ki Meiru Sandman (Trap negate) are all 1900 ATK Level 4 EARTH Rocks that Tribute themselves as Quick Effects to negate and destroy the opponent's plays. Because all four share the EARTH Attribute and Rock Type, revealing a single Rock monster in your hand during the End Phase satisfies all of their maintenance costs without needing Iron Core, and Tributing any of them on your turn triggers Koa'ki Meiru Supplier in your hand.

summary.title: Bosses & Extra Deck
points: Koa'ki Meiru Maximus banishes an Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru from your hand to Special Summon itself with 3000 ATK and destroys an opposing card every turn.
Gallant Granite detaches a material to search Koa'ki Meiru Supplier, Guardian, Overload, Wall, or Sandman directly from the Deck.

Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger King, made with Urnight and Crusader, Sets Fire Formation - Tenki from the Deck, while Missus Radiant boosts all EARTH Koa'ki Meirus by 500 ATK/DEF and recovers one from the GY when destroyed.

summary.title: Spells
points: Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru is revealed in hand to activate Urnight and pay maintenance costs, and can return itself from the GY to your hand during your Draw Phase.
Core Transport Unit discards a card once per turn to search Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru from the Deck.
Adamancipator Signs revives any Rock-Type Koa'ki Meiru monster from the GY after it Tributes itself to negate an opposing card.

main: Koa'ki Meiru Supplier

Core Level 4 EARTH Rock extender: Special Summons itself from your hand whenever a face-up Rock monster you control is sent to the GY, and searches Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru or a card mentioning it when Special Summoned!
Koa'ki Meiru Guardian
Level 4 EARTH Rock (1900 ATK): tributes itself as a Quick Effect when a monster effect is activated to negate the activation and destroy that monster.
Koa'ki Meiru Overload
Level 4 EARTH Rock (1900 ATK): tributes itself as a Quick Effect when your opponent would Summon a monster(s) to negate the Summon and destroy that monster(s).
Koa'ki Meiru Wall
Level 4 EARTH Rock (1900 ATK): tributes itself as a Quick Effect when your opponent activates a Spell Card to negate the activation and destroy it.
Koa'ki Meiru Sandman
Level 4 EARTH Rock (1900 ATK): tributes itself as a Quick Effect when your opponent activates a Trap Card to negate the activation and destroy it.
Koa'ki Meiru Urnight
Core Level 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior (2000 ATK): reveals 1 Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru in your hand once per turn to Special Summon any Level 4 or lower 'Koa'ki Meiru' monster directly from your Deck!
Koa'ki Meiru Crusader
Level 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior (1900 ATK): adds 1 'Koa'ki Meiru' card from your GY to your hand whenever it destroys an opponent's monster by battle.
Koa'ki Meiru Maximus
Level 8 WIND Dragon boss (3000 ATK): banishes 1 Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru from your hand to Special Summon itself and destroys 1 card your opponent controls every turn.
Diamond Core of Koa'ki Meiru

Core Spell: adds any 'Koa'ki Meiru' card (except itself) from your Deck to your hand, AND banishes itself from your GY so Koa'ki Meiru monsters you control cannot be destroyed for the rest of this turn.
Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru
Signature Spell: revealed in hand to pay maintenance costs and activate Urnight's Deck-summon effect, and adds itself from the GY to your hand during your Draw Phase.
Core Transport Unit
Continuous Spell that discards 1 card once per turn to add 1 Iron Core of Koa'ki Meiru from your Deck to your hand.
Ties of the Brethren
Targets 1 Level 4 EARTH Rock Koa'ki Meiru to summon 2 others from the Deck—setting up Guardian + Overload + Wall on Turn 1!
Fire Formation - Tenki
Searches Koa'ki Meiru Urnight or Crusader and keeps a Beast-Warrior / Continuous Spell presence.
Adamancipator Signs
Revives Guardian, Overload, Wall, or Supplier from the GY.
